 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 99.1 </B></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>Yum! Brands, Inc. Enters into Agreements to Sell Pizza Hut for $2.7 Billion </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><I>Pizza Hut, excluding Mainland China, to be Acquired by LongRange Capital; Pizza Hut in Mainland China </I></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><I>to be Acquired by Yum China Holdings, Inc. in Separate Transactions </I></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Key highlights: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt"><I>Positions Yum! Brands for Long-Term Growth and Shareholder Value Creation </I> </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt"><I>Completes Yum!&#8217;s Previously Announced Strategic Review of Pizza Hut</I> </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt"><I>Yum! Brands and Yum China Partner on KFC Growth Incentives </I> </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt"><I>Board Approves Incremental $4 Billion Share Repurchase Authorization</I> </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>LOUISVILLE, Ky., June</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;16, 2026 &#8212;</B><B></B>&nbsp;Yum! Brands, Inc. (NYSE: YUM) (&#8220;Yum!&#8221; or the &#8220;Company&#8221;)
today announced that it has entered into definitive agreements to sell Pizza Hut for $2.7&nbsp;billion in the aggregate, subject to certain purchase price adjustments. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Pizza Hut, excluding Mainland China (&#8220;Pizza Hut <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Ex-China&#8221;),</FONT> will be acquired by LongRange Capital
(&#8220;LongRange&#8221;), a private equity firm with a customer-centric and operationally oriented approach, and Pizza Hut in Mainland China (&#8220;Pizza Hut China&#8221;) will be acquired by Yum China Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: YUMC; HKEX: 9987)
(&#8220;Yum China&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Following a comprehensive review of strategic options for Pizza Hut that commenced in November 2025, Yum!&#8217;s leadership
team and Board of Directors determined the sale provides the strongest path to maximize shareholder value while providing Pizza Hut an ownership structure tailored to its distinct markets, competitive strengths and long-term priorities under
leadership with significant relevant QSR experience. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;These transactions enable Yum! to be a more focused company that continues to leverage scale,
technology and talent to&nbsp;accelerate our raising the B.A.R. priorities and deliver sustained value for our stakeholders,&#8221; said Chris Turner, Chief Executive Officer, Yum! Brands. &#8220;Under LongRange and Yum China, Pizza Hut will be well
positioned for future growth with ownership that brings deep expertise in the restaurant industry. Pizza Hut is one of the most iconic restaurant brands in the world, and we are proud of the important role it has played in Yum!&#8217;s history.
Pizza Hut was built by the passion and dedication of our team members, employees and franchisees, and we&#8217;re excited for the next chapter.&#8221; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Yum! Brands and Yum China remain fully committed to a strong partnership that unlocks growth in their joint businesses going forward. The companies have
agreed to certain financial incentives that will generate value for both companies&#8217; shareholders should KFC China&#8217;s future system sales growth rates accelerate. In addition, the companies will work together to further advance long-term
growth plans for Taco Bell in Mainland China. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Transaction Details </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Under the terms of the agreement with LongRange, Yum! will sell Pizza Hut <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Ex-China</FONT> to LongRange for approximately
$1.5&nbsp;billion. Additionally, Yum! has the opportunity to receive an <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">earn-out</FONT> of $75&nbsp;million by 2030. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">1 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Under the terms of the agreement with Yum China, Yum! will sell Pizza Hut China to Yum China for
approximately $1.2&nbsp;billion. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Across the two transactions, Yum! expects to receive approximately $2.3&nbsp;billion of net proceeds after taxes,
closing adjustments and transaction-contingent fees, excluding the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">earn-out.</FONT> Yum! additionally expects to incur <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">one-time</FONT> expenses of approximately $85&nbsp;million
during the remainder of 2026 to effectuate the separation. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Yum! will continue to provide Byte by Yum!, its proprietary technology platform, to Pizza Hut <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Ex-China.</FONT> Additionally, Yum! will provide certain corporate services to Pizza Hut <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Ex-China,</FONT> under a transition services agreement to support an orderly separation. Yum!
expects the fees received for these services in 2026 to offset Yum! corporate G&amp;A expenses historically allocated to Pizza Hut. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Management will
provide additional information regarding the financial impact of the transaction, including any related updates to its 2026 financial outlook, during Yum!&#8217;s second-quarter earnings conference call scheduled for July&nbsp;30, 2026. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The transactions have been unanimously approved by Yum!&#8217;s Board of Directors. Yum! expects both transactions to close in the third quarter of 2026,
subject to customary closing conditions, including receipt of required regulatory approvals. Following the close of the transactions, Yum! will no longer report on the Pizza Hut division. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Barclays and Goldman Sachs are serving as financial advisers to Yum!. Weil, Gotshal&nbsp;&amp; Manges LLP and Mayer Brown LLP are serving as legal advisers to
Yum!. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Share Repurchase Program </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The net <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">after-tax</FONT> proceeds will be used in accordance with the Company&#8217;s capital allocation strategy, including investing in the business and returning excess capital to shareholders. Concurrent with approval of the
transactions, Yum!&#8217;s Board of Directors approved an incremental $4&nbsp;billion authorization for the repurchase of common stock. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>About Yum!
Brands </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Yum! Brands, Inc., and its subsidiaries franchise or operate more than 63,000 restaurants in 155 countries and territories under its iconic
brands &#8212; KFC, Taco Bell, Pizza Hut and Habit Burger&nbsp;&amp; Grill. KFC, Taco Bell and Pizza Hut are global leaders in the chicken, Mexican-inspired food and pizza categories, respectively. Habit is a fast-casual concept known for fresh, <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">cooked-to-order</FONT></FONT> food. Fueled by Yum!&#8217;s Recipe for Good Growth, KFC, Taco Bell and Pizza Hut led Entrepreneur&#8217;s 2026 Franchise 500 rankings and its Top Global
Franchises 2025 list. In 2026, Yum!&#8217;s unrivaled culture and talent led it to be named one of TIME magazine&#8217;s list of Best Companies for Future Leaders for the third consecutive year. </P>
